_doc: Shared fixture table for the run-liveness + verification-pending lockstep test (amicode#2055, #2056). Asserted against BOTH status implementations (extension service + engine overlay) and, for eligibility, the extension's promoteEligibility. Ages are seconds before 'now'; lock is the run.lock contract (scratchpad/run-lock-contract.md). finished is the raw FINISHED file body. log_age_s null = no run.log. Optional: tier = solvespec.json tier; verification = verification.toml body ({agree, pending, reason} or {raw}); expect_verification = the status payloads' `verification` field (absent => field omitted); expect_eligibility defaults to 'eligible'.

cases.name: no lock, warm log -> solving (legacy)
no lock, cold log -> stalled (legacy)
no lock, no log, fresh run.toml -> solving (legacy)
no lock, finished -> finished (legacy)
no lock, failed -> failed (legacy)
fresh heartbeat, warm log -> solving
fresh heartbeat, cold log -> stalled (live orchestrator, quiet solver)
heartbeat just inside threshold (89 s) -> not dead
heartbeat just past threshold (91 s), warm log -> dead
stale heartbeat, cold log -> dead (beats stalled)
stale heartbeat, no log -> dead
stale heartbeat + completed FINISHED -> finished (marker wins)
stale heartbeat + failed FINISHED -> failed (marker wins)
stale heartbeat + aborted FINISHED -> aborted (marker wins)
stale heartbeat + torn FINISHED -> still dead (torn is not terminal)
stale heartbeat but ended=true, no FINISHED -> not dead (legacy cold-log rule)
stale heartbeat but ended=true, warm log -> solving
ended=false explicit, stale -> dead
corrupt lock file -> legacy (warm log -> solving)
corrupt lock file -> legacy (cold log -> stalled)
lock without heartbeat_at -> legacy
lock with unparseable heartbeat_at -> legacy
lock with non-object JSON -> legacy
pending marker (free), fresh lock, warm log -> solving, pending_verification, not eligible
pending marker (free) + completed FINISHED -> finished, pending_verification (not suppressed)
pending marker (free) + stale heartbeat, no FINISHED -> dead (dead shown), still pending_verification
pending marker on a run with no solvespec -> never eligible
pending marker on a non-free tier -> never eligible
final verification agree=true replaced the marker -> eligible, no pending field
final verification agree=false replaced the marker -> suppressed, no pending field
explicit pending=false with agree=false -> suppressed (only pending=true is the marker)
pending as a string is not the marker -> suppressed
free tier, no verification.toml yet -> pending_verification eligibility, no marker field
non-free tier, no verification -> eligible (only free is gated)
